basic_info.description: Welcome to 235 Westgate Drive, a classic 1930 Spanish Mediterranean fixer in prestigious Mount Davidson Manor! This 5-bed, 3-bath home offers 2,656 sq. ft. of charm-filled living space with rare original architectural details and excellent bones ready for your vision.  You’ll be drawn in by its curb appeal—arched doorways, stucco façade, and iconic Spanish tile roof. Inside, enjoy generously sized rooms, original hardwood floors, and beautiful woodwork throughout.  Upstairs features 3 spacious bedrooms and a full bath. The standout primary bedroom includes an oversized picture window with sweeping Pacific Ocean views.  The main level offers 2 more bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms—perfect for guests, extended family, or a home office setup. Downstairs, a large rumpus room with full bath adds versatility for an additional bedroom, entertainment area, or home gym. Bonus: there’s a separate water closet near the laundry area.  A two-car tandem garage includes an automatic opener, laundry hookups, and ample storage. The rear garden is low-maintenance—ideal for relaxing or entertaining.  Located near West Portal & Lakeside Village, Stonestown Galleria, top schools, and easy access to 280/101 and transit. A rare opportunity you don’t want to miss!
